note: pct values are proportions; quote them as percentages with 'digits' decimals. pp = percentage points. 'value' is the Python value; 'python' and 'r' are the rounded values from each language.

results.name: true_prevalence
results.meaning: True share of the 1,000 AI replies that contain an error (hidden truth)

results.name: n_true_errors
results.meaning: Number of truly erroneous replies

results.name: lenient_share_of_labels
results.meaning: Share of all labels given by the 3 lenient rubber-stampers

results.name: pairwise_agreement
results.meaning: Raw agreement between pairs of labelers on the same item (looks reassuring)

results.name: mv_prevalence
results.meaning: Error rate according to the majority-vote answer key

results.name: mv_sensitivity
results.meaning: Share of real errors the majority-vote key labels as errors

results.name: mv_wrong
results.meaning: Golden-set labels that are wrong under majority vote (of 1,000)

results.name: mv_missed_errors
results.meaning: Real errors the majority-vote key calls OK

results.name: mv_accuracy
results.meaning: Majority-vote key accuracy against the truth

results.name: ds_prevalence
results.meaning: Error rate according to the Dawid-Skene answer key

results.name: ds_sensitivity
results.meaning: Share of real errors the Dawid-Skene key labels as errors

results.name: ds_expected_prevalence
results.meaning: Dawid-Skene expected error rate (average posterior probability, no 0.5 cut-off)

results.name: ds_wrong
results.meaning: Golden-set labels that are wrong under Dawid-Skene (of 1,000)

results.name: ds_missed_errors
results.meaning: Real errors the Dawid-Skene key calls OK

results.name: ds_accuracy
results.meaning: Dawid-Skene key accuracy against the truth

results.name: ds_iterations
results.meaning: EM iterations to converge (tolerance 1e-9 on posteriors)

results.name: mae_sens_ds
results.meaning: Mean absolute gap between DS-estimated and true (realized) labeler sensitivity, 14 labelers with 30+ labels, percentage points

results.name: mae_sens_mv_referenced
results.meaning: Same gap when each labeler is scored against the majority-vote key, percentage points

results.name: corr_sens_ds
results.meaning: Correlation between DS-estimated and true (realized) labeler sensitivity

results.name: ds_targeted_wrong
results.meaning: Wrong labels after DS + adjudicating the 100 most uncertain items

results.name: ds_random_wrong
results.meaning: Wrong labels after DS + adjudicating 100 random items

results.name: random_expected_net_fixed
results.meaning: Expected net labels fixed by a random 100-item expert budget (exact: 100 x (7.8% x 0.98 - 92.2% x 0.02)); display 'about 6'

results.name: random_net_fixed_lo95
results.meaning: Lower end of the 95% range of net fixes from a random 100 (exact hypergeometric x binomial distribution)

results.name: random_net_fixed_hi95
results.meaning: Upper end of the same 95% range

results.name: random_p_net_le_2
results.meaning: Probability that a random 100 nets 2 or fewer fixes (how unlucky this draw was)

results.name: targeted_expected_net_fixed
results.meaning: Expected net fixes for the targeted 100 with a fresh 98% expert (37 x 0.98 - 63 x 0.02); realized was 37

results.name: mv_margin_wrong
results.meaning: Wrong labels after MV + adjudicating the 100 narrowest-margin items

results.name: mv_random_wrong
results.meaning: Wrong labels after MV + adjudicating 100 random items

results.name: targeted_items_wrong_before
results.meaning: Of the 100 targeted items, how many the DS key had wrong (the budget's hit rate)

results.name: random_items_wrong_before
results.meaning: Of the 100 random items, how many the DS key had wrong

results.name: ds_targeted_sensitivity
results.meaning: Share of real errors the final key (DS + targeted) labels as errors

results.name: ds_targeted_prevalence
results.meaning: Error rate according to the final key (DS + targeted)

results.name: final_wrong_ambiguous_share
results.meaning: Share of the final key's remaining wrong labels that sit on the 10% ambiguous items

results.name: mv_ties
results.meaning: Items with a tied majority vote (2-2), assigned 'OK' by the tie rule

results.name: n_items_under_3_labels
results.meaning: Items left with fewer than 3 valid labels after skips

results.name: judge_precision_mv
results.meaning: AI judge's measured precision when scored against the majority-vote key

results.name: judge_precision_ds_targeted
results.meaning: AI judge's measured precision against the final key (DS + targeted)

results.name: judge_precision_truth
